componentBoundary.reason: One container owns the WebGL renderer, generated glyph atlas, pointer state machine, responsive fit, lifecycle observers, and cursor label.

transitions: hold for 0.9 seconds: holding to charged
pointer up: charged to idle with release ripple
pointer leave or cancel: any to idle

state.hovering: Controls the cursor-follow label and pointer dissolution strength
state.visibility: Pauses rendering outside the viewport or in a hidden tab

renderModel.glyphAtlas: 512 px wide, 8 columns, generated with the source GeistMono font
